cv_default.note: default pipeline is untuned; this is a cross-validated estimate on ESC-50 only, not a drone result

false_alarms.note: Targets are ESC-50 aircraft clips; there is no drone class. esc50_crossfit false alarms come from joined 5 s ESC-50 clips scored by models that never saw them; they are not long continuous recordings. Rates have wide exact Poisson intervals when the hours are few. t_on acts on the smoothed probability inside the alert logic (m5.alert), not on the window-level threshold of M4. At low scenario SNR part of the event recall is chance: the background itself raises false alarms at low thresholds, and an alarm within match_tol_s of a clip counts for it. To use the point: set m5.alert.t_on in configs/default.yaml.

range.note: Model estimate, not a measurement. The required SNR comes from ESC-50 aircraft clips (there is no drone class in the data) and the source level is not assumed. The sensitivity table shows the range for hypothetical required SNRs, not for the measured one.
range.primary_curve_axis: clip in-band power over background stream in-band power (M6)
range_estimate_missing_inputs: snr_min_db: the m6_event_recall_at_operating_point curve never reaches recall 0.9 (best 0.075)
simplifications: free field, spherical spreading from a point source (no ground reflection, no ground effect)
one broadband SNR; no frequency weighting and no A-weighting
no wind or temperature gradients, no refraction, no turbulence
no reverberation (indoor bench tests break this assumption)
constant ambient level and constant atmospheric absorption along the path
the SNR threshold comes from ESC-50 aircraft clips, not from drone recordings

config.cv: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle, seed=1337) on source group, trained on clean audio

robustness.note: ESC-50 only, aircraft versus ambient. Noise kinds white and pink are synthetic; 'ambient' uses ESC-50 recordings of classes the SVM was also trained on as negatives.

reference.definition: median in-band (100-7000 Hz) power of the 80 aircraft clips; the same absolute noise level is added to every clip

causal_vs_zero_phase.note: Out-of-fold, same grouped folds as M3. `tested on causal features` uses the audio filtered the way the live engine filters it. Windows are gated on the zero-phase RMS in both cases.

paired_saved_model.note: saved model, trained on all windows (in-sample): a paired description, not an accuracy

snr_estimate.noise: pink, in-band power 1e-4 (rms 0.01 after the band-pass)
snr_estimate.note: Truth of a window = power of the clip alone in that window over the noise power, both in-band. The engine's noise floor comes only from windows it does not flag, so a clip it misses leaks into the floor.

speed.note: Wall time on the machine that ran this, one process. First window includes library warm-up. Real-time factor < 1 means the engine keeps up; the window time must stay below the 500 ms hop.

real_clips.note: no clean reference exists for real clips; these are rank and power statistics, not quality scores
